section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) System
title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) System

content.description: EGR system schematic showing exhaust gas recirculation path with EGR Port, R Port, Temp. Sensor, EFI Computer, VSV, EGR Vacuum Modulator, EGR Valve, Pressure Chamber, and EGR Cooler

Alternative EGR system schematic with similar components but different configuration, showing EGR Port, R Port, Temp. Sensor, EFI Computer, VSV, EGR Vacuum Modulator, EGR Valve, Pressure Chamber, and EGR Cooler

content.text: To reduce NOx emission, part of the exhaust gases are recirculated through the EGR valve to the intake manifold to lower the maximum combustion temperature.

headers: Pressure in the EGR Valve Pressure Chamber
rows: Positioned be- tween EGR port and R port*
*Pressure con- stantly alter- nating between low and high

content.text: Remarks: *Pressure increase → Modulator closes → EGR valve opens → Pressure drops → EGR valve closes → Modulator opens →

**When the throttle valve is positioned above the R port, the EGR vacuum modulator will close the atmosphere passage and open the EGR valve to increase the EGR gas, even if the exhaust pressure is insufficiently low.
